'''The Flail''' was a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization active on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the years immediately before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

Self-justified with [[The Flail Manifesto]], the Flail accused the politicians of its time of corruption, particularly of benefiting specific companies while slighting the individual citizen. Strangely, The Flail was mostly composed of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and although they accepted [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] such as [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] into the organization, they were not readily preferred. The Flail considered that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] was particularly corrupt.

The Flail performed several guerrilla attacks on Coruscant, disrupting communications, traffic, trade, and weather control systems. They damaged structures and cared little about possible deaths. Whenever they detected a known authority force, such as a member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]], they would immediately attempt to escape the premises rather than fight.

==History==
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the Flail unjustly accused [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] of corruption, and the chancellor's reputation suffered as a result. Fearing that he would be thrown out of office, Valorum decided to fight The Flail as his last important action while in office. As part of this measure, Valorum's Judicial Department forces captured or killed many members of The Flail, including the entire leadership.

However, The Flail survived with a new leader, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] smuggler [[Zegmon Pent]]. Pent publicly and falsely claimed to be a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using assassin trained by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and his Flail members firmly believed his claims.

===Attack on Valorum===
Valorum publicly announced that the remnants of The Flail would be jailed before the following Senate hearing. Pent organized reprisals against Valorum in response, including death threats and an unsuccessful assault against Valorum's aide [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]]. Meanwhile, Valorum and his ally [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] organized a strike team of previously-unknown agents to foil the Flail's imminent attempt against Valorum's life.

The Flail sent its main expert in explosives, [[Senn Riip Domeet]], to hide a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] in the platform where Valorum was to give his conference the following day. Although Domeet was disguised, he assumed that he had been discovered and attempted to escape.

However, The Flail had prepared several contingency plans in case of such an occurrence, one of which was to take control of the [[Weather Modulation Control Center]] and unleash a powerful thunderstorm in the unprotected buildings surrounding the area which the discourse was to take place. Pent had developed a re-programming software for the weather modulation controls, and sent several Flail members to the center to sabotage the machinery. However, Valorum and Windu had correctly assumed that this would be The Flail's following step, and the terrorists were greeted by Valorum's new security agents.

The Flail immediately enacted their third contingency plan, to enter the [[Air Traffic Control|Traffic Control Center]], and from there remote-pilot a vehicle and hurl it against the meeting building. Pent and seven agents arrived there ten minutes before the speech. Once again, they were met by Valorum's agents and were foiled before they could enact their [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempt.

===Later history===
{{Quote|That's it! I'm done waiting for someone else to take care of these criminals. It's time to act!|[[Acun Solari]] to a Rebel operative|<ref name="SWG:E" />}}
The Flail was present on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:E" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Corellian Security Force]] discovered the [[Flail hideout]] on the planet Talus, leading to a [[CorSec vs. Flail Battle|battle]] between CorSec troopers and Flail henchmen.<ref name="SWG:CvFB" /> During that time, the Flail cutthroats were also in conflict with the [[Hidden Daggers]] pirates.<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> In fact, the Hidden Daggers were founded by a disavowed Flail [[Assassin/Legends|cutthroat]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]].<ref name="SWG:PK">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=conversation|Prisk Kith'Vys|Talus}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] transporting a [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] crash-landed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], in the wilderness near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]]. Although the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] quickly dispatched a rescue ream, the first to find the crash site were a group of Flail thugs.<ref name="SWG:E" /> Looking for ship parts to salvage,<ref name="P14.1">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=734|text=Update Notes: Publish 14.1 - March 24, 2005}}</ref> the criminals assassinated the Rebel pilot on the spot. The Flails then attacked the group of Rebel operatives sent to rescue the pilot but they were all killed. The Rebel operatives later reported to Rebel [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Acun Solari]]. Solari was deeply outraged that a hero of the Alliance could be assassinate without reason by common criminals. In retaliation, the officer ordered the Rebel operatives to strike at several criminal groups in the Corellian system. On Corellia, the operatives attacked a Flail camp near Tyrena and killed 15 of them.<ref name="SWG:E" />
